title: Aspiring writer-director here. I’ve got a question.

commenti.body:
The first one looks easier to write and can be further developed. Good film references would be Rain Man or even Little Miss Sunshine

The second one is interesting but require much visualization to be honest. This kind of movie requires themes and tbh passion. I think Parajanov's film are on a similar vein. My favorite of this kind of film is the House is Black. But this kind of films are hit or miss. 

I pick the first one since I think there is more references that have  similar plots out there to guide you as abeginner

Petty comment, the titles can definitely be better but I guess this are working ones lol. 

 Also, I just enjoy movies and not connected to filmmaking whatsoever.
